title: Mathematical aspects of registration methods in bounded domains
summary: Registration methods in bounded domains have received significant attention in the model reduction literature, as a valuable tool for nonlinear approximation. The aim of this work is to provide a concise yet complete overview of relevant results for registration methods in $n$-dimensional domains, from the perspective of parametric model reduction.
